articles.title: Javier Milei saludó a EEUU por el Día de la Independencia: "Argentina fue un país fundado bajo este mismo anhelo"
articles.summary: President Milei posted a message on social media for US Independence Day, drawing parallels between the values of both nations and emphasizing shared principles of freedom and democratic liberalism.

articles.title: Finalmente, Javier Milei no viajará a Estados Unidos por el Día de la Independencia
articles.summary: After several deliberations, President Milei did not travel to the United States for Independence Day celebrations as initially considered, focusing instead on domestic agenda changes including cabinet modifications.

articles.title: Javier Milei participó de la celebración por el Día de la Independencia en la Embajada de EEUU y recibió otro respaldo del gobierno de Trump
articles.summary: President Milei attended the US Independence Day celebration at the US Ambassador's residence in Buenos Aires, with cabinet members present, and received explicit support from the Trump administration for deepening bilateral alliance.
